channel.title: APK Law, Advocates: Notes and Reflections
channel.description: Analytical pieces, case comments, and short reflections on questions of law.

item.title: Data Processing Agreements under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023
item.description: An examination of the contractual architecture of the Data Processing Agreement under the DPDP Act, 2023 and the Rules, 2025, covering scope of processing, security obligations, sub-processing controls, breach notification, retention and deletion, liability allocation, and audit rights.

item.title: Liability of Directors Under India's New Labour Codes
item.description: An examination of the deemed criminal liability provisions across all four labour codes, the occupier concept under the OSH Code, the functional test for who is in charge of the company's business, the position of non-executive and independent directors, the due diligence defence, and the corporate governance implications of the new penalty architecture.

item.title: Convertible Instruments in Early-Stage Startup Investments
item.description: An examination of the contractual architecture and negotiation dynamics of the CCD, CCPS, and convertible note in Indian early-stage investment transactions, including conversion mechanics, anti-dilution protection, pre-conversion investor rights, and FEMA pricing constraints.

item.title: Settlement Agreements in Commercial Disputes: Accord and Satisfaction
item.description: An examination of the discharge of commercial contracts by accord and satisfaction under Section 63 and novation under Section 62 of the Indian Contract Act, and the survival of arbitration clauses in the light of the Supreme Court's decision in Krish Spinning and the Delhi High Court's decision in B.L. Kashyap.

item.title: Shareholder Agreements in Early-Stage Startups: Part 2 – Investor Protections and Exit Mechanisms
item.description: An examination of information rights, pre-emption, anti-dilution protection, liquidation preference, put options, tag-along rights, and the full range of exit mechanisms in Indian early-stage shareholder agreements, with particular attention to the economic consequences for founders.

item.title: Shareholder Agreements in Early-Stage Startups: Part 1 – Governance and Founder Rights
item.description: An examination of the document architecture, board composition, reserved matters, founder lock-in and reverse vesting, transfer restrictions including ROFR, ROFO, tag-along and drag-along, and the founder rights that deserve careful attention in Indian early-stage shareholder agreements.

item.title: Exclusion Clauses in Commercial Contracts: Incorporation and the Limits of Risk Allocation
item.description: An examination of the two-stage framework for exclusion clauses in Indian commercial contracts, the plain meaning principle under SAW Pipes, the distinction between liability exclusion and scope definition, and the drafting considerations that determine whether an exclusion clause achieves its intended commercial purpose.

item.title: Material Adverse Change Clauses in Indian M&A Agreements
item.description: An examination of the contractual architecture of MAC clauses in Indian acquisition agreements, the judicial constraint under Section 56 of the Contract Act, the anatomy of the MAC definition and its carve-outs, interaction with representations and conditions precedent, and specific drafting approaches for the Indian context.

item.title: MSMED Act: Delayed Payment Protections and Commercial Contract Implications
item.description: An examination of the delayed payment framework under Chapter V of the MSMED Act, 2006, covering the forty-five day payment ceiling, compound interest under Section 16, the Section 22 and Form MSME-1 disclosure obligations, MSEFC enforcement, and the structuring of supply agreements to give full effect to the Act's protections.

item.title: Privity of Contract and Third-Party Rights under the Indian Contract Act, 1872
item.description: An examination of the privity rule under Indian law, its statutory framework, the trust and agency exceptions, the commercial contexts in which the rule bites, and the structural approaches available for conferring enforceable third-party rights in commercial transactions.

item.title: Term Sheets in Startup Funding: Anatomy, Binding Obligations, and the Limits of Enforceability
item.description: An examination of the anatomy of a startup investment term sheet, the selectively binding architecture under market practice, the agreement-to-agree problem under the Indian Contract Act, and the doctrinal limits of enforceability.

item.title: Arbitral Seat and Venue: The Distinction and Significance in Arbitration Agreements
item.description: An examination of the distinction between the juridical seat and the physical venue of arbitration under Indian law, the BALCO and BGS SGS Soma framework, the practical consequences of the seat determination, and the drafting approach required to avoid jurisdictional ambiguity.

item.title: DPDP Act: An Introduction to India's Data Protection Framework
item.description: An introduction to the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, covering its scope, the data fiduciary and processor distinction, the consent framework, individual rights, significant data fiduciaries, breach notification, cross-border transfers, the penalty framework, and what organisations should do to prepare.

item.title: POSH Act Part 2: Inquiry Process, Penalties, and Employer Liability
item.description: An examination of the complaint filing process, conciliation, the ICC inquiry procedure, findings and recommendations, appeals, employer liability and penalties under Section 26, third-party harassment obligations, and the compliance priorities for employers under the POSH Act, 2013.

item.title: Founders' Agreements: Equity Split, Roles, and Pre-Investment Arrangements
item.description: An examination of the key provisions of a founders' agreement under Indian law, covering equity split, roles and decision-making authority, inter-se governance, lock-in and the departure framework, intellectual property assignment, and pre-incorporation arrangements.

item.title: Non-Disclosure Agreements: Scope, Carve-Outs, and Breach
item.description: An examination of the drafting architecture of NDAs under Indian law, covering the definition of confidential information, standard carve-outs, the receiving party's operational obligations, the disclosure and confidentiality period framework, remedies for breach, and the case for keeping NDAs simple.

item.title: POSH Act Part 1: Employer Obligations and ICC Constitution
item.description: An examination of the foundational employer obligations under the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act, 2013, covering the definition of sexual harassment, scope of coverage, mandatory ICC constitution, the policy requirement, Section 19 obligations, and the annual report.

item.title: Impossibility and Frustration of Contract under the Indian Contract Act, 1872
item.description: An examination of the frustration doctrine under Section 56 of the Indian Contract Act, the practical impossibility standard from Satyabrata Ghose, the Energy Watchdog restatement, temporary impossibility and suspension, and the drafting relationship between force majeure clauses and the statutory regime.

item.title: Employment Agreements for Senior Hires: Key Clauses, Negotiation, and Drafting
item.description: An examination of the principal clauses of a senior executive employment agreement under Indian law, covering compensation structure, equity, term and termination, post-termination restrictions and garden leave, intellectual property obligations, and the provisions that determine practical enforceability.

item.title: Liquidated Damages and Penalty Clauses in Commercial Contracts
item.description: An examination of Section 74 of the Indian Contract Act, the genuine pre-estimate principle, common contract types where LD clauses appear, negotiating and responding to LD provisions, and the drafting errors that deprive these clauses of their commercial purpose.
